21.note: Up to three draws decide one outcome. Draw 1: 5-9 offers only choice 1; 0-4 leads to draw 2. Draw 2: 8-9 offers only choice 2; 0-7 leads to draw 3. Draw 3: 9 offers only choice 3; anything else is death. Proposed schema: a when on random effects, random conditions that name the draw (1st, 2nd, 3rd), and a death effect.

29.note: The text gives a Mindshield-dependent penalty but does not say this enemy is immune to Mindblast, so no immunity is encoded.

36.note: The fall is treated as a wound, so Healing can restore it.

113.note: Footnote 1 gaps: Laumspur eaten as a Meal should also restore 3 ENDURANCE; the player should choose which Meal item to eat; and Laumspur may be used at any time, because the pre-combat restriction belongs to the Healing Potion.

144.note: Theft: the player loses one Backpack Item of their choice; with no Backpack or no Backpack Items, one Weapon of their choice instead. Proposed: a loseOne effect with a slot and a fallback slot, resolved as a pending player choice. The 2 ENDURANCE from the collision is a wound.

147.note: Footnote 2 changes only the directions in the wording; both choices keep their targets.

162.note: Lose every Weapon and the Backpack itself with all its contents; Gold and Special Items are kept. Proposed: a loseAll effect for slots, plus a 'has Backpack' state so Backpack Items cannot be carried until a new Backpack is found.

166.note: Fidelity question for Barry: the mental ordeal is classed as non-wound loss, so Healing cannot restore it. The text offers no Mindshield exception.

180.note: Evasion is allowed before or during any of the three fights.

184.note: The 40 Gold Crowns are optional. Proposed: allow gold in pickup, e.g. {op:'pickup', items:[...], gold:40}. The Meal follows the pickup, so a found Meal may be eaten.

188.note: On 0-6 the Backpack itself is lost with all its contents (see 162's proposal); the hook applies only then. The 7-9 arm wound is encoded.

205.note: Lose every Weapon and every Backpack Item; the Backpack itself is kept. Proposed: a loseAll effect for slots.

212.note: Restore ENDURANCE to the maximum, clearing hunger and fatigue loss too. Proposed: a restoreEndurance effect.

227.note: Choice 1 only if Lone Wolf lost any ENDURANCE in this combat; choice 2 only if none. Proposed condition: combatLoss as a range over ENDURANCE lost in the section's latest combat.

231.note: If the Robber is alive after 4 rounds, the fight stops and only choice 2 is offered. Choice 1 follows a win within 4 rounds; evasion is open from round 2. Proposed: a combat maxRounds with a timeout choice, and a condition telling a win from a timeout.

236.note: Base COMBAT SKILL drops by 1 permanently, carried into later books. Proposed: a combatSkill effect that changes the base value. Only one Gem is lost. The 6 ENDURANCE is a wound.

255.note: The Prince's Sword is treated as an ordinary Sword.

263.note: The 3 Gold Crowns are optional; see 184's proposal.

294.note: Lose every Weapon and the Backpack itself with all its contents (see 162's proposal).

347.note: Footnote 3: any number of Torches, one Backpack slot each, so eight are offered (the Backpack's limit).

349.note: Fidelity question: the Pendant is worn, not packed, so it is a Special Item, although the text never says so. Footnote 4 makes keeping it optional.
